def read_adb_response(data):
    if len(data)<24: raise ValueError('short ADB header')
    command,arg0,arg1,length,check,magic=struct.unpack('<6I',data[:24])
    if command^magic!=ADB_MAGIC_MASK: raise ValueError('bad ADB magic')
    if command not in (CNXN,AUTH): raise ValueError('unsupported ADB command')
    if length>MAX_ADB_LENGTH: raise ValueError('oversized ADB body')
    if len(data)!=24+length: raise ValueError('bad ADB body length')
    body=data[24:]
    if check!=checksum(body): raise ValueError('bad ADB checksum')
    if command==CNXN:
        banner=body.decode('utf-8')
        return ('CNXN',(arg0>>16)&255,(arg0>>8)&255,arg0&255,banner)
    return ('AUTH',arg0,arg1,body)

```python
class Ledger:
    def __init__(self, rows):
        rows.sort(key=lambda r: r[0])
        self.rows=rows; self.index=0; self.states={}
    def advance(self, q):
        rows=self.rows; states=self.states; i=self.index; n=len(rows)
        while i<n and rows[i][0]<=q:
            _, key, rev, content = rows[i]; i+=1
            st=states.get(key)
            if st is None: states[key]=[rev,{content}]
            else:
                if rev>st[0]: st[0]=rev; st[1]={content}
                elif rev==st[0]: st[1].add(content)
        self.index=i
    def visible(self):
        live=deleted=conflict=0
        icmp=[]; app=[]
        for st in self.states.values():
            cs=st[1]
            if len(cs)>1: conflict+=1; continue
            for c in cs: break
            if c[0]=='d': deleted+=1
            elif c[0]=='i': live+=1; icmp.append(c)
            else: live+=1; app.append(c)
        return (live,deleted,conflict), icmp, app
```

def parse_record(values, context, lookup):
    if len(values) != 14: raise Invalid('field count')
    typ = values[0]; rid = values[1]
    if typ not in ('icmp','app'): raise Invalid('type')
    if not ident(rid): raise Invalid('id')
    rev = decimal(values[2], 10**9)
    pub = decimal(values[3], MAX_TIME)
    op = values[4]
    rest = values[5:]
    if op == 'delete':
        if any(rest): raise Invalid('delete fields')
        return (pub, (typ, rid), rev, ('d',))
    if op != 'put': raise Invalid('op')
    lease, event_text, probe, target_text, responder_text, result, service, attempt_text, payload_text = rest
    leases = context['leases']
    L = leases.get(lease)   # careful: lease must be a string key; if lease is '' → not found ✓

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Local sanity runner: emulates public_check without raising rlimits."""
import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace')
from _json_result import check_result

ROOT = Path('/workspace')
SUB = ROOT / 'submission'

def run_one(raw, work):
    env = {'PATH': '/usr/bin:/bin', 'HOME': '/workspace', 'LANG': 'C', 'LC_ALL': 'C',
           'TMPDIR': str(work), 'PYTHONHASHSEED': '0'}
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', str(SUB / 'campaign.py')],
                       input=raw, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                       cwd=str(work), env=env)
    return p

def main():
    cases = json.loads((ROOT / 'examples' / 'fixtures.json').read_text())
    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] != '-':
        cases = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
    ok = True
    for case in cases:
        raw = case['raw'].encode() if 'raw' in case else json.dumps(case['input']).encode()
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir='/workspace/tmp') as work:
            t = time.time()
            p = run_one(raw, work)
            dt = time.time() - t
        if p.returncode:
            print('FAIL', case['name'], 'exit', p.returncode, p.stderr.decode()[-2000:]); ok = False; continue
        try:
            check_result(p.stdout, case['expected'])
            print('PASS', case['name'], '%.2fs' % dt, 'stderr:', p.stderr.decode()[:200])
        except ValueError as exc:
            ok = False
            print('FAIL', case['name'], exc, '%.2fs' % dt)
            print('  got     :', p.stdout.decode()[:3000])
            print('  expected:', json.dumps(case['expected'])[:3000])
            if p.stderr: print('  stderr:', p.stderr.decode()[-2000:])
    return 0 if ok else 1

if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
